problems: e20: pin ↔ stud is not a compatible pair
notes: The booklet has no inventory pages and few parts boxes, so element IDs are best-guess matches to the catalogue. Colours are in props. Pieces with no catalogue match use new lego-unknown-* types.
Many pieces (yellow bodywork, rear deck plates, wing joins) are inferred from the step pictures. Exact counts and positions of fuselage plates, bricks and slopes may differ from the real model.
Wing wedge plates use lego-unknown-wing-wedge. Left and right copies are not mirrored because the catalogue has no mirror twin.
The pilot minifig (page 2) is built first and sits on the seat at step 26.
Stickers (tail number, wing roundels) are not modelled.
The control lever (step 8) is approximated as a connector peg in the side stud of the 1x2 brick.
Landing gear (step 25) is approximated as a wheel-holder plate with two hubs and tyres, attached under the black 2x4 plate.
The 2x sub-assembly of a black 1x1 plate on a gray 1x1 clip plate is modelled as a repeat. The second copy is attached to the cockpit-side brick instead of the black plate.
The upper wing (page 20) is four wedge plates around a yellow 2x4 plate, with a yellow wedge and two round tiles on top. It sits on the two dark red struts.
